name: layout-text-flip
blurb: Text flips on 3D axis as layout or content changes.
description: Uses Framer Motion to create a 3D card-flip effect when content swaps, revealing new text on the flip side.
use_when: Toggle or tab interfaces where flipping the card signals state change.
avoid_when: Dense content — the flip animation makes the transition harder to follow.
a11y: During flip, text is not readable. No keyboard trigger unless manually wired.
